Name: Joys of Efficiency
Author: yakminepunyo
Description:
[b][color=#ff7700][size=5]Joys of Efficiency(JoE)[/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][u]Any comments, endorsements, bug reports, requests are welcome![/u][/size][/color][/b]
[b]
[size=4]Do you want to use JoE with beta versions of StardewValley?[/size]
[size=4]You can download beta releases (currently supports SDV 1.3.31) from [url=https://github.com/pomepome/JoysOfEfficiency/releases]GitHub Release page[/url][/size].
[size=4]If you have any questions or bug reports about beta releases, please open Issue at GitHub instead of Nexus.

If you are using Android port of SMAPI and encountered Harmony related errors, try enabling SafeMode.
It bypasses Harmony patching, so it should suppress errors.[/size]

[size=4][OVERALL]
[/size][/b][size=4] ﻿This mod is a configurable utility set mod which can help the gameplay be more efficient. (See above for details.)
﻿And the settings can be changed through config.json (it should be created after the first run)
﻿Or you can change it in in-game settings menu by pressing [i][b]KeyShowMenu[/b][/i] (Default:[b]R key[/b]).
﻿This mod works on client side completely. (You don't have to be a host to take effect)[/size][size=4]
﻿Also, this mod now supports gamepads.

[b][BUG REPORTING][/b]
﻿If you found a bug, post the situation to the Bugs tab with a version(game, SMAPI, and also this mod) and
﻿logs if you have.[/size]
[color=#ff0000][size=5]
﻿﻿DO NOT REPORT IT TO POSTS TAB because it's harder to track
﻿than Bugs [/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=5]tab.[/size][/color]
[size=3]
﻿Before reporting, please check you are using the latest version (maybe fixed), and there are no similar reports.
﻿Thank you for your cooperation.

[/size][size=4][b][What's new?][/b]
If you want to know what's new of the latest updates, you can check it through following link.
[/size][size=4]  ﻿ [url=https://github.com/pomepome/JoysOfEfficiency/blob/develop/JoysOfEfficiency/WhatsNew.md] ﻿for Stable versions[/url](after 1.0.22)[/size]
